# Nouveau Wellness Center

> Non-invasive face and body treatments (Cryo Facial + LED, HydroFacial, Nano Facial, Cryo Face & Neck Lift, CryoSkin body sculpting, Lipo Laser + Cavitation) at five Florida wellness centers. No needles, no downtime. New clients: first face or body treatment $79.99 at any location. Open Sunday to Friday 10 AM to 6 PM, closed Saturday. CareCredit financing available.

## Locations
- Port Charlotte (flagship): 3221 S Tamiami Trail, Port Charlotte, FL 33952 · (941) 726-3055
- Estero: 9250 Corkscrew Rd #6, Estero, FL 33928 · (239) 788-2860
- Naples: 9010 Strada Stell Ct, Naples, FL 34109
- Port St. Lucie: 1810 SE Port Saint Lucie Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34952 · (772) 280-5572
- Ocala: 11740 SW 97th Terrace, Ocala, FL 34481 · (352) 414-0717

## Treatments
- [HydroFacial](https://nouveauwellnesscenter.com/hydrafacial): deep cleanse, extraction and hydration, about 45 minutes
- [Cryo Facial + LED](https://nouveauwellnesscenter.com/cryo-facial): controlled cooling plus red and blue LED light, about 45 minutes
- [Nano Facial](https://nouveauwellnesscenter.com/nano-facial): needle-free Benelift nano-infusion, about 60 minutes (Port Charlotte and Estero)
- [CryoSkin body sculpting](https://nouveauwellnesscenter.com/cryoskin): controlled cooling for abdomen, arms, thighs and back
- [Lipo Laser + Cavitation](https://nouveauwellnesscenter.com/lipo-laser): low-level laser and ultrasound body contouring
